text: いい　できばえ　じゃないか！

structure.jp: いい　できばえ　じゃないか！
structure.en: that's a fine result, isn't it!

patterns.name: 〜じゃないか
patterns.span: できばえ　じゃないか
patterns.explanation: じゃないか at the end doesn't really ask; it says something strongly, like 'isn't it!' or 'why, it is!'. いい できばえ じゃないか = 'why, that's fine work!'.
